description: OR-combine disjoint BOX bitfields in _round (^->|, verified pairwise-disjoint 0x0007f800/0x07f80000/0xf8000007/0x000007f8, value-identical); +0.17% within noise. ncu@real cfg Vec1/T512: 98.4% L1/LDS + SM roofline, DRAM/L2 idle; 8 LDS/round fundamental, tables not rotations (distinct S-boxes), cannot shrink (bank conflicts) or merge (512KB); at roofline

roll forward GOST rounds (3 identical passes) into #pragma unroll 1 loop to lower register/I-cache pressure; value-identical (same ops/order). +0.28% vs 934.8 baseline, within ~1-2% noise; selftest PASS. Disproves occupancy lever: LSU/LDS pipe already ~98% busy so more resident warps do not help; unroll structure is irrelevant, confirms prior roofline.

lower GOST P-transform 4x4 byte transpose from mask/shift/or to PRMT via hc_byte_perm (3 prmt/word, control words verified value-identical); selftest PASS. 936.8 = +0.21% vs 934.8 baseline, within ~1-2% noise and below prior discards (936.4/937.4). Confirms P is not the bottleneck: ptxas already lowers the byte-gather idiom and the LDS pipe (~98%, 128 loads/R) binds regardless of SM-side ALU. 3rd principled discard; mode at LDS+SM roofline.

extract S-box index bytes in hot _round via prmt (hc_byte_perm sel 0x444k) instead of shr+and; value-identical byte selection, selftest PASS. 938.2 = +0.36% vs 934.8 baseline, within ~1-2% noise (highest of 4 discards: 936.4/937.4/936.8/938.2). Distinct from discard#3 (PRMT on COLD P-transform); this targets the HOT _round index-gen (128 LDS/R). No effect => ptxas already lowers shr+and to minimal BFE/PRMT and the kernel is LDS-transaction bound (~98% LSU pipe), so SM-side byte-extraction is not the co-limiter. Roofline reconfirmed (4th principled discard).

drop provably-redundant &0xff on the top-byte S-box index in hot _round ((t>>24)&0xff -> t>>24; value-identical for unsigned u32x). selftest PASS. 935.5 = +0.07% vs 934.8 baseline, within ~1-2% noise and the lowest of 5 discards (936.4/937.4/936.8/938.2/935.5). As expected a compiler no-op: ptxas already lowers (t>>24)&0xff to a single SHR. Confirms hot-path instruction selection has zero residual slack; combined with #1(OR-combine)/#3(PRMT P)/#4(PRMT extract) this is the 5th principled SM-side discard. Load-count is fundamental (8 LDS/round, distinct S-boxes cannot merge, 16-bit tables=512KB>shared), bank conflicts are information-theoretically irreducible (bank=index%32 on a uniform gather; a fixed bijection cannot help), constant-mem is a known divergent-serialization regression. Mode at LDS+SM roofline.

fold same-word (x<<16)^(x>>16) rotate pairs -> hc_rotl32 in the psi-mixing macros SHIFT12 (20 folds) + SHIFT61 (17 folds); value-identical (disjoint bit halves => ^==| == rotl16), selftest PASS. 935.7 = +0.10% vs 934.8 baseline, within ~1-2% noise (prior discard cloud 935.5-938.2). FIRST experiment on the psi-mixing/SHIFT path (all 5 priors targeted the S-box lookup path). Hypothesis: mixing runs in a serial non-LDS phase between passes so its pure-ALU cost is not overlapped/hidden by the LSU-bound lookups, making it an independent lever. Result disproves it: no measurable change => mixing ALU is not a co-limiter and ptxas already lowers the shift^shift idiom to funnel-shift (extends the #3/#4 finding from the lookup path to the mixing path). 6th principled discard; LDS+SM roofline reconfirmed, now with the last untested code region closed.
